body.statement: For design A, \(|\mathcal T_A(p,m)|=1\) if and only if the finite observable rank/support/cycle conditions returned by \(\mathscr A(T,m)\) hold. For design B, \(|\mathcal T_B(p)|=1\) if and only if the corresponding residual-forest and cycle conditions returned by \(\mathscr A(T)\) hold. For an arbitrary real input \(\zeta\), every rigid output is either a rational expression in \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\) or a uniquely ordered real element of a finite algebraic extension, certified by a square-free polynomial in \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}[q]\) and Thom sign data. If \(\zeta\) is explicitly rational, this certificate may instead be normalized to a square-free integer polynomial and rational isolating interval. Every nonrigid output contains two legal full SCMs with identical observables and supplied margins, when supplied, but different \(\tau\); both SCMs are strictly positive whenever the nonrigid stratum is interior.
body.justification: This is the necessary-and-sufficient theorem-level kernel and gives an exact coefficient-field meaning to every atlas output.
body.gap: Published proxy results give sufficient full-rank formulas, while published factorization results target nuisance uniqueness rather than PN/PS constancy.
body.consumer: Analysts receive a definitive identification certificate or an explicit observational-equivalence refutation for any fixed finite selected table.

obligation.what_is_open: Necessity and sufficiency of the proposed finite structural atlas on every mixed-support design-A and design-B fiber.
obligation.obstruction: The theorem depends on the unresolved mixed-support elimination question, which is not owned by this solve unit. The established rank-two orientation boxes and residual-margin forest do not prove that the proposed inactive-row, coincident-endpoint, and algebraic-root charts exhaust every real component and support face. Generic two-copy quantifier elimination would decide target constancy but would not prove the claimed structural classifier.
obligation.attempted: Extended the established cycle-to-SCM lift, the all-rank-two orientation classification, and the conditional residual-forest elimination to the theorem's two completed branches; audited whether their chart arguments cover rank-one and inactive-row degeneracies, where the missing component-exhaustion step remains.
obligation.partial_result:
The established cycle-to-SCM lift gives the exact image equalities
\[
\mathcal T_A(p,m)=\{\tau_C(b,a):(b,a)\in\mathcal C_A(T)\},
\qquad
\mathcal T_B(p)=\{\tau_C(b,a):(b,a,m,g,\pi)\in\mathcal C_B(T)\}.
\]
Thus any two cycle points with different \(\tau_C\) lift to legal full SCM twins, including on boundary faces; strict positivity is required only for interior faces. The established all-rank-two design-A theorem supplies exact oriented endpoint boxes and a necessary-and-sufficient agreement test there. The established design-B residual theorem eliminates the positive unknown margins, conditional on \((b,a,\rho)\), by negative residual proportionality, forest scale propagation, cycle products, normalization, and the relevance inequality. These arguments prove the claimed conclusion on those branches. They do not show that the proposed mixed-support chart list exhausts every real component and support face of either full cycle fiber.
